title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22

ai_review.summary: An excellent matrix recording of a smoking 1973 show, highlighted by an epic China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and a sublime Bird Song.
ai_review.review: This matrix capture is praised as crystal‑clear and richly detailed, letting listeners hear the Wall of Sound’s full depth. The performance is described as “monster” and “sublime,” with standout moments on China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Bird Song, Here Comes Sunshine, Wharf Rat and a fiery Jack Straw. Energy runs high from start to finish, and the band’s interplay – especially Phil’s bass bombs and Jerry’s soaring lead – is repeatedly lauded.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 27 of 31 reviews are 5‑star, praising both the performance and the matrix sound; only a few low scores mention minor crowd‑noise concerns, yielding an overall rating well above average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the matrix crisp, rich and beautifully separated, noting Hunter Seamons’ masterful blend of soundboard clarity with audience ambience. A single negative comment mentions added crowd noise, but the consensus is that the recording delivers near‑perfect listening experience.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows seamlessly with a powerful second‑set jam marathon; transitions are praised and the show is described as a “monster 73 show” from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His lead solo on China Cat Sunflower is highlighted as one of his best, with soaring guitar tone and plaintive vocals noted throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly praised for “bombs” – a thunderous bass that seemed to explode the room, especially during the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Bob: Acknowledged for delivering his first lead solo in the jam (China) and for strong rhythm/vocal contributions.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano solo on ‘The Race Is On’ is singled out; overall keyboard work is praised as fluid and inventive.
